The published report is `src/content/blog/anime.md`. Charts, derived tables, and the checksum check are produced by `scripts/build_brief.R`.

```bash
npm run brief:anime
```

That command reads the raw TidyTuesday `tidy_anime.csv`, asserts SHA-256 `5ea3a14492b5c559c728af0c7ec57b81c919d0efa4d381e54b0f7cde9934a1c2`, collapses the file to one row per `animeID`, and writes the five figures under `charts/`.
